Remodel exist. detached temporary living quarters to bring up to code: removing and replacing interior partion wall replace windows and upgrade electrical and per expired permit # 2001-005030 Relocate Exsiting Plbg Line Change Out. Not to be used as a two family residential without a change of use permit


On July 25 2008 a STOP WORK ORDER was issued to the above referenced address.

Permit number 2008-003204 was obtained for 1904 Anita Dr. and was approved for the remodel of an existing detached garage to be used as a temporary living quarters. 

Permit # 2001-005030 was expired at the time of the application for the new permit so the scope of work that was permitted under permit number 2008-003204-BP had to include the upgrade of the electrical and the relocating of the exiting plumbing line. 
 
Based on the current inspections performed by the City of Austin (COA) Residential Inspection Division the current permit is in violation of the 2006 International Residential Code Ordinance No. 20071018-089 Sections R105.4 and R107.4.  According to the application for this permit the use is for a masonry garage to be used as temporary living quarters.  In order to become compliant and to have the Stop Work Order removed you must accomplish the following:

	Obtain a plumbing and mechanical permit for work performed without proper permits.  

	Apply for and receive a Change of Use status permit on the Garage Apartment.

Please be aware that any occupancy of the structure occupied without compliance is a violation of 2006 International Residential Code Ordinance No. 20071018-089 Section 105.4. 

During this Stop Work Order you may not further develop on this site nor transport construction materials to the site.  As the owner of this property and permit you must resolve this issue with the City of Austin.
